title: ROUND ( -2.5, 0 ) is -3 as a decimal number

source.quote: Ties are broken by rounding half away from zero (also known as commercial rounding)
source.supports: ROUND rounds a half away from zero; its return value is a decimal number

derivation: -2.5 is exact in binary, a true tie between -3 and -2. Half away from zero gives -3; ROUND returns a decimal number, so -3.0. Round half to even, or half up toward positive infinity, would give -2.0.
